# Indeed Scraper

The Apify actor [`misceres/indeed-scraper`](https://apify.com/misceres/indeed-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.117**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape jobs posted on Indeed. Get detailed information from this job portal about saved and sponsored jobs. Specify the search based on location with the output attributes position, location, and description.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Job listing $0.006 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/misceres/indeed-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/misceres-indeed-scraper@0.0.117#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | string |  |  | Positions/keywords for search — Any combination of positions or keywords for search. Can be used together with Start URLs - both will be scraped independently, each limited by Max job listings per search. |
| `maxItemsPerSearch` | integer |  |  | Max job listings per search — Maximum number of job listings to scrape for each keyword search and each Start URL. When both are used together, each is limited independently by this value. |
| `country` | string |  | `"US"` | Country for search — Country for job search. |
| `location` | string |  |  | Location for search — Any combination of city, zip code or locality for search. Used together with position/keywords. |
| `parseCompanyDetails` | boolean |  | `false` | Scrape company details — If true, each job also includes company details: description, website URL, logo, company size and rating. These come from the same API response as the job itself, so turning this on costs no extra requests. |
| `saveOnlyUniqueItems` | boolean |  | `true` | Save only unique job listings — If true, only unique job listings will be scraped. |
| `followApplyRedirects` | boolean |  | `false` | Follow redirects for apply link (no longer needed) — Has no effect. `externalApplyLink` is now always the employer's own apply URL, because it comes resolved from Indeed's API instead of being followed by the scraper. Left in place so existing runs keep working. |
| `startUrls` | array |  |  | Start URLs — List of URLs that will be scraped. Can be main website URL, category/search URLs, company jobs URL (in the format of `https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Google/jobs`) or detail/product URLs. Can be combined with keyword search - both will execute independently. |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `positionName` | string \| null | Job position title |
| `salary` | string \| null | Salary information as displayed on the job listing |
| `jobType` | array \| null | List of job types (e.g. Full-time, Part-time, Contract) |
| `jobSetting` | array \| null | Remote-work arrangement (e.g. Remote, Hybrid work, In-person). Localised per country |
| `experienceLevel` | array \| null | Experience level the job asks for: Entry level, Mid-level, Senior level or No experience needed |
| `company` | string \| null | Name of the hiring company |
| `companyIndeedUrl` | string \| null | URL of the company's page on Indeed |
| `location` | string \| null | Job location |
| `rating` | number \| null | Company rating on Indeed (0 if not available) |
| `reviewsCount` | number \| null | Number of company reviews on Indeed |
| `externalApplyLink` | string \| null | External link to apply for the job on the employer's website |
| `url` | string \| null | URL of the job listing on Indeed |
| `id` | string \| null | Unique job ID on Indeed |
| `postedAt` | string \| null | Age of the job listing as displayed on Indeed (e.g. '3 days ago') |
| `postingDateParsed` | string \| null | ISO 8601 date when the job was posted |
| `scrapedAt` | string \| null | ISO 8601 date when the job was scraped |
| `description` | string \| null | Full plain-text job description |
| `descriptionHTML` | string \| null | Full HTML job description |
| `companyInfo` | object \| null | Detailed company information, available when parseCompanyDetails is enabled |
| `searchInput` | object \| null | Search parameters used to find this job listing |
| `urlInput` | string \| null | Start URL used to scrape this job, if applicable |
| `isExpired` | boolean \| null | Whether the job listing has expired |
| `error` | string \| null | Error code, present when the scraper encountered a known error condition |
| `errorDescription` | string \| null | Human-readable description of the error code |
